notes: «بعض أصحابه يرفعه إلى» is one unnamed link (rule 8); the Imam after «إلى» is written inside the chain, so he is a narrator (owner ruling 2)
«قَالَ قُلْتُ نَكُونُ بِمَكَّةَ» : the first-person speaker «قلت» is not named; whether he is بعض أصحابه or another man is not in the text (rule 11, first-person narrative)
